name: mroffice-editors-desktop
description: MR Office Editors: the MR Office desktop app's shell, open source. With the free MR Office component it opens and saves Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files; without it, the open-source editors.

scripts.start: npm run build && node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron .
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/app-state.test.mjs test/component.test.mjs test/default-app-offer.test.mjs test/document-target.test.mjs test/document-thumbnail.test.mjs test/editors-server.test.mjs test/files.test.mjs test/launch-cache.test.mjs test/navigation.test.mjs test/permissions.test.mjs test/prelaunch.test.mjs test/service-log.test.mjs test/web-port.test.mjs
